title: Levenshtein Algorithms: Dynamic Programming, Bit-Parallel & Automata | Levenshtein.net

sections.heading: Algorithms for Levenshtein Distance
sections.evidence: This section covers the principal algorithms for computing and exploiting Levenshtein distance, including classical dynamic programming, distance-sensitive methods, bit-parallel techniques, finite-state automata, advanced exact algorithms, and indexing strategies for approximate matching.
paragraphs: This section covers the principal algorithms for computing and exploiting Levenshtein distance, including classical dynamic programming, distance-sensitive methods, bit-parallel techniques, finite-state automata, advanced exact algorithms, and indexing strategies for approximate matching.

01 Indexing and Filtering for Edit Distance: Exact Similarity Search at Scale Learn exact edit-distance search at scale using length bounds, q-grams, partitioning, tries, Levenshtein automata, metric indexes, and exact verification. Article · 18 min read

02 Landau–Vishkin Algorithm: Bounded Edit Distance & Approximate Matching A rigorous guide to the Landau–Vishkin algorithm: farthest-reaching edit paths, diagonals, LCE queries, bounded edit distance, approximate matching, complexity, correctness, and implementation. Article · 38 min read

03 Masek–Paterson Algorithm: Four Russians Edit Distance A rigorous guide to the Masek–Paterson algorithm for edit distance: Four Russians blocking, boundary step vectors, precomputation, discrete costs, complexity, LCS, reconstruction, and limitations. Article · 38 min read

04 Levenshtein Automata: Finite-State Fuzzy String Matching A rigorous guide to Levenshtein automata: NFA and DFA construction, edit transitions, characteristic vectors, Schulz–Mihov automata, trie intersection, complexity, and implementation. Article · 41 min read

05 Myers Bit-Vector Algorithm: Bit-Parallel Edit Distance A rigorous guide to Myers' bit-vector algorithm for approximate string matching: relocatable dynamic programming, Pv/Mv encoding, Peq masks, carry propagation, complexity, global adaptation, and implementation. Article · 39 min read

06 Ukkonen Algorithm: Banded, Output-Sensitive Edit Distance A rigorous guide to Ukkonen's edit-distance algorithm: diagonal bands, thresholds, output-sensitive complexity, correctness, memory reduction, weighted costs, and implementation. Article · 28 min read

07 Wagner–Fischer Algorithm: Dynamic Programming for Edit Distance A rigorous guide to the Wagner–Fischer algorithm for edit distance, including recurrence, correctness proof, matrix construction, backtracking, weighted costs, complexity, memory optimization, and implementation. Article · 29 min read
